verdict.rationale: Poke has a documented programmatic API, so the story applies. However, probes of all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404, and the API docs summary explicitly states no machine-readable spec is published. llms.txt is a general LLM-readable overview, not an API specification, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
